```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidypopgen)
library(bigsnpr)
library(httr)
library(parallel)
```

```{r}
mad_bor_g1000_sum <-
  gt_load("../data/intermediate/rbind_data/mad_bor_g1000_sum_neo_clean_ld.gt")
```

# Use liftOver to lift hg19 snps to PanTro6

```{r}
bim <- show_loci(mad_bor_g1000_sum)[, c("chr_int", "name", "genetic_dist", "position", "allele_ref", "allele_alt")]

names(bim) <- c("chr", "name", "genetic_dist", "pos", "a1", "a0")

pan_bim <- snp_modifyBuild(
  info_snp = bim,
  liftOver = "/usr/local/bin/liftOver",
  from = "hg19",
  to = "PanTro6",
  check_reverse = FALSE,
  local_chain = NULL,
  base_url = "https://hgdownload.soe.ucsc.edu/goldenPath/"
)

pan_bim <- na.omit(pan_bim)

```

# Get chimp reference base for each SNP

```{r}
get_chimp_base <- function(chr, pos, sleep_time = 0.1) {
  # Build region string (example: "1:123456-123456")
  region <- paste0(chr, ":", pos, "-", pos)

  # Ensembl species name for chimp
  species <- "pan_troglodytes"

  # Use the main Ensembl REST API
  url <- paste0(
    "https://rest.ensembl.org/sequence/region/",
    species, "/", region,
    "?content-type=text/plain"
  )

  # Pause briefly to avoid hitting rate limits
  Sys.sleep(sleep_time)

  # Query the API
  r <- GET(url)

  # Check for failure
  if (status_code(r) != 200) {
    warning(paste("Query failed for", chr, pos))
    return(NA)
  }

  # Return the sequence (single base for SNP)
  return(content(r, "text", encoding = "UTF-8"))
}
```

```{r}
tictoc::tic()

pan_bim$chimp_base <- mcmapply(
  get_chimp_base,
  chr = pan_bim$chr,
  pos = pan_bim$pos,
  mc.cores = 4
)
tictoc::toc()
```

# Save chimp reference data

```{r}
colnames(pan_bim) <- c("chr_int", "name", "genetic_dist", "position", "allele_ref", "allele_alt", "chimp_ref_base")
saveRDS(pan_bim, "../results/s06_f_stats/mad_bor_g1000_sum_snps_with_chimp.rds")
```

# Clean up chimp reference data

```{r}
# remove NAs
pan_bim_no_na <- na.omit(pan_bim)
pan_bim$triallelic <- NA
remove_triallelic <- function(pan_bim){
  three_alleles <- c(pan_bim["allele_ref"], pan_bim["allele_alt"], pan_bim["chimp_ref_base"])
  if(length(unique(three_alleles))==3){
    pan_bim["triallelic"] <- TRUE
  } else {
    pan_bim["triallelic"] <- FALSE
  }
}

pan_bim_no_na$triallelic <- apply(pan_bim_no_na, 1, remove_triallelic)

# filter out triallelics
pan_bim_filtered <- pan_bim_no_na[pan_bim_no_na$triallelic == FALSE, ]
```

```{r}
nrow(pan_bim_filtered)
```

# Subset original hg19 gt to only those in chimp reference

```{r}
mad_bor_g1000_sum_chimp <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>%
  select_loci_if(loci_names(genotypes) %in% pan_bim_filtered$name)
```

```{r}
gt_save(
  mad_bor_g1000_sum_chimp,
```

# Create a gen_tibble of the chimp reference alleles

```{r}
if(file.exists("../data/intermediate/pan_tro_liftover/chimp_ref.gt")){
  file.remove("../data/intermediate/pan_tro_liftover/chimp_ref.gt")
  file.remove("../data/intermediate/pan_tro_liftover/chimp_ref.bk")
  file.remove("../data/intermediate/pan_tro_liftover/chimp_ref.rds")
}
```

```{r}
loci <- show_loci(mad_bor_g1000_sum_chimp)
indiv_meta <- data.frame(id = "chimp_ref", population = "chimp_ref")
genotypes <- matrix(rep(1, nrow(loci)), nrow = 1, ncol = nrow(loci))

chimp <- gen_tibble(
  loci = loci,
  indiv_meta = indiv_meta,
  x = genotypes,
  backingfile = "../data/intermediate/pan_tro_liftover/chimp_ref"
)
```
